title: Zainab si behan hai
body:
Mehsoos kare koi to, dil kaap uthega
sailaab e ghamo dard hai, roke na rukega
khud kaatib e taqdeer basad dard likhega
maqtal ki zamee'n roegi, zindaan kahega
<<MINI>>
Pardes hai ghurbat hai, (barabar ki thakan hai)..(2)
Abbas sa bhai hai to, (zainab si bahan hai)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ek saniye zehra hai, to ek saniye haider
shabbir ka ek bhai hai, (aur ek hai khwahar)..(2)
Hai boodhe ali bhai , (bahan rashke chaman hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ek zamine chadar hai, sabhi ehle haram ka
aur ek ki rida dhoop mein, (saaya hai alam ka)..(2)
ek dharas e shabbir hai, (ek qalb e hasan hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dono ne wafao'n ka, bharam aise rakha hai
ye hukm ka paband wo, (paband e haya hai)..(2)
ek tashna e paykar hai, (ek tashna dahan hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dono hi alamdaar e wafa hai sare maidaa'n
ye asr se pehle wo, (pase shaame ghareeba'n)..(2)
kaapa huwa sehma hua, (dono se hi rann hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ek majlis o matam ki, bena daalne wali
ek baad e shahadat bhi hai, (maidaan ka ghaazi)..(2)
ek hai bani hashim ka qamar, (ek kiran hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bazu the bandhe sar tha, khula jab ke behan ka
be bazu alamdaar tha, (mohtaj kafan ka)..(2)
dono ke kalejo me, (musalsal ye chubhan hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes...
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Wo barsare naiza tha, ye kaa'nto pe rawa thi
sar uska gira naize se, (ye mehwe fugha thi)..(2)
ye khoon ki taseer hai, (rishto ki lagan hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes...
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Abbas ki ik aankh mein jab teer chubha tha
dil thaam ke zainab ne, (basad dard kaha tha)..(2)
majboor hu bhaiyya mere, (haatho'n me rasan hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes...
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Rehan o raza zainab o ghaazi ki dua hai
wallah ye shehzaadi, (sakina ki ataa hai)..(2)
is nauhe me taaeed e (shehenshahe zaman hai)..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pardes hai ghurbat hai, (barabar ki thakan hai)..(2)
Abbas sa bhai hai to, (zainab si bahan hai)..(2)
